• Drive backups encrypted with a fixed password + weekly random recall check + manual unlock for new devices
• Restore history (file/Drive/cloud) with trash-based undo
• Data-protection layers: atomic writes + post-upload verify + staleness warning + shrink threshold
• 1..7 Drive versions of your choice + full backup incl. trash, geofence and folders
• First-install permission review + pinned header with menu + past/today/upcoming reminder tabs

• 30-day trash: delete moves to trash with restore, permanent delete and auto-purge
• Arrival reminder via location geofence (radius + optional name)
• Scheduled automatic cloud backup (daily/weekly at dawn) with result notification
• List search with highlighted context line + special-block cards in the editor

• Hardened lock against guessing: unlock works from the first digit and every attempt counts + neutral “Try again” message + lock after 3 attempts only • Folder color change fixed + folder card tinted with its color in the list • Favorites screen with two tabs: active and later-archived — archived notes can never be added to favorites

• Clearly new look: always-visible search + color chips on show + color stripe on every colored card\n• Wide add button with label + bolder header + editor save button with “Save” text\n• Same gold and fonts — visibly different at first glance

• Material 3 redesign of all screens: official SearchBar + FilterChips + Snackbar with Undo instead of dialogs\n• Slimmer editor bar (prominent save + rest in menu) + steady contrast on all note colors\n• All touch targets 48dp + full RTL with the same golden identity
• Instant WYSIWYG formatting while typing — no write/preview switch\n• Toolbar on top of the editor + split preview removed
• Bottom formatting toolbar + split mode removed from the editor
• Background unified into the + sheet + single-row toolbar + top bar capped at 5 actions

• Secure shredding before delete (optional in Settings — Pro) with three methods: Single Pass, DoD 5220.22-M and Schneier 7-Pass\n• Subscription plans updated: built-in PIN pad for Free and shredding for Pro\n• Method names in English in both locales

• Search is now a button opening a dynamic field in the header instead of a fixed box\n• Built-in PIN pad with no external keyboard + in-pad fingerprint + manual submit\n• Advanced settings merged into Settings + About moved to the side drawer

• Unified backup screen in the drawer + Account screen with Free and Pro cards\n• Search in the top bar + logo and version at the top of the drawer\n• Security hardening: signing secret out of the repo + encrypted token vault
• Server verifies the login token itself — no more blind trust\n• Automatic Nota Cloud backup after unlock for subscribers\n• Silent token refresh with no interruptions
• Text is also encrypted with your key before upload — the server sees nothing\n• Cloud key section: view/create/import the recovery phrase\n• Voice recording cap: 30 minutes or 32 MB
• Photos and audio upload encrypted to Nota Cloud (subscribers)\n• One failed file never aborts a backup + old backups stay restorable
• Premium launch screen + full media encryption (PBKDF2 at 310k rounds)\n• Audio and photos sealed at capture + keys wiped from memory
• Categories: free note labels + management screen + filtering\n• Unified Backup screen (Drive + Nota Cloud) from the side drawer\n• Plan-based storage quota + extra packs for subscribers
• Nota Cloud: backup and restore on our server with your own quota (100 MB free) from the Cloud screen
• Fixed database crash after reinstall + automatic recovery with cloud restore
• Folder organization + duplicate screens removed + account photo fix + cleaner home cards
• Full redesign + navigation drawer + separate account screen + unified design language
• Premium warm design + paid (PRO) features with paywall
• New selected notebook icon (yellow notebook on brown) — launcher, in-app badge and splash
• New notebook icon (uxwing) in gold on white — launcher, in-app badge and splash
• White circular icon everywhere + start-aligned app name + unified back bar + PIN keyboard fix + RTL/LTR audit + code cleanup
• Fixed Advanced, About and Lock texts in night mode + new transparent-background icon inside and outside the app
• Fixed Settings screen texts in night mode (were unreadable black) — now a clear theme-following color
• Fixed add-button crash (infinite measure inside scroll) — height is now measured for real
• Ruled lines now stick to the text exactly while scrolling, with no gap
• Fixed launch crash (a Hilt class was wrongly stripped during code shrinking)

• Ruled paper fully synced with the text (positions from the text engine)
• All screens follow the theme, including system bars
• Distinctive fonts: Amiri headings, Tajawal body (DM Serif for English)
• Lighter Arabic weight and taller line height for diacritics
• New color spec: warm paper, amber seed, 8 note slots
• Card and chip borders plus clearer date colors

• Instant lock when the phone screen turns off
• Note color next to search with a larger writing area
• Ruled paper that scrolls with the text
• Dark-mode colors and text readability fixes
• Allow/block screenshots option
• Per-note actions menu and batch multi-select
• First official release: local encryption + PIN & fingerprint\n• Fully offline — no network permission at all\n• Instant Arabic search, archive, and Sticky Notes colors

Real protection: PIN and biometric lock, on-device encryption, screenshot blocking, and secure shredding before delete — no accounts, no ads, no tracking.
